answer: Start with Bitcoin inscription ownership proof. The idea is simple: an inscription owned since an early block, and that juniper alone separates one real agent from a hundred fakes. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so an inscription owned since an early block stays private; the crystal is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the grove is that the farm's unit economics never work.
